svg.title: Packet Processing — One Run
svg.desc: A mobile-friendly flow showing one intake packet moving from visitor submission through API ingestion, queue-based packet loading, a four-agent Azure AI Foundry crew, persisted outcome, front-desk approval, and continuous live updates.

text.tspan: From packet submission to front-desk approval
Starts a live or recorded run
The worker assembles one complete packet for agent processing
Policy, patient data, and eligibility support validation.
The Summary agent makes no external tool call.
Code persists the proposed result; a person controls the final decision
